  File: changelog.d/37432054768-merge-guard-env-chdir.md
  Line or code reference: filename
  Problem: The numeric prefix is an 11-digit workflow run identifier, not an issue or PR number. CLAUDE.md §20 specifies `changelog.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` where the number is the issue or PR the work belongs to (e.g. `changelog.d/3712-soft-deadline-finalization.md`); PR/issue numbers are 6-7 digits in 2026.
  Why it fails at runtime: this is a contract violation rather than a runtime defect — `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` would still fold it into `CHANGELOG.md`, but the filename loses the issue/PR traceability the convention exists to preserve, and a future operator chasing "what PR added this fix" through changelog fragments has to guess the link instead of reading it off the path.
